assertions.source: sin(Im𝔙/πℏ) oscillation produces a zero of N_odd in the substrate window — the feature the RAW Im(ι₁₃) form (A3 probe) lacked

assertions.name: one_instanton_amplitude_at_committed_scale
assertions.source: one-instanton amplitude vs committed A = S·u³ magnitude

assertions.name: one_instanton_slope_within_2_orders
assertions.source: one-instanton slope at the phase-zero vs committed A′≈2.37

description: One-instanton magnitude test for the A_ω normalization map (OneInstantonNormalization.lean, PR #4246). Parameter-free (𝒜=1, P=1, ℏ=log q) test of N_odd = e^{-Re𝔙/πℏ}·sin(Im𝔙/πℏ) against the committed BarOddLadderShape (A~S·u³ scale, A′≈2.37). RESULT: the sin oscillation supplies a zero-crossing (q_z≈1.1013) the raw Im(ι₁₃) form lacked, and the exponential amplitude matches the committed A magnitude to ~0.009 orders (~2%) with NO tuning; the slope is ~4.3 orders too gentle (the committed steepness is the separate 1/u³ lever amplification). scope-(a): constrains the prefactor/lever, not an ingredient exclusion. No fit; no c_k wired.
